summary: The retirement projection now lets pay earned before retiring cover its own tax, even in a year when a required withdrawal is due. Before, the whole year's tax, including tax on a pension and Social Security, was taken out of the withdrawal, which made savings look worse than they are.
points: Example: at 75 with a $3,000 pension, $9,781 of a $12,195 withdrawal is put back, not $8,767
A required withdrawal is worked out on last year-end's balance, not on money put in that year
A spending figure typed just above the loans no longer drops off a cliff
Three more fixes are ready but switched off, because they would change answers already checked by hand
numbers: Only 3 sample plans move, each for the better

summary: A workboard note says the retirement engine's last three parts have landed, the builder has released its claim, and hand-offs for the next builders are listed.

Every form in the app now speaks in plain words right at the box: a wrong entry gets a short message under it instead of a browser pop-up, and nothing jumps around under your finger. Figures are read the way you type them, like "1,200" or "5%".
points: Return moves to the next box and saves only from the last one
A one-tap change can be undone from the confirmation message
Optional boxes can fold under a quiet "More details (optional)" line
No page uses the new options yet, so nothing on screen changes until a page asks
